title: Another One Bites The Dust
summary:
Product carriers gain from another California refinery closure
Last year, we wrote a Tanker Opinion titled " Another Refinery Retires ", triggered by the announcement of Phillips 66, the 4th largest refiner in the U.S., to cease crude oil processing operations at its 138,700 b/d dual-sited refinery in Los Angeles, California. Last month, another refinery closure was announced. Valero Energy said that it would cease operations at its 170,000 barrel per day (b/d) Benicia refinery in the San Francisco area.
